root: ^You were lucky I found you in the forest unconscious.
^Even though you were missing an arm...
^I restored your arm with one of those monsters arms.
^You can now use it in you favour.
^But I ask you to help me in return.
^Kill thoses monsters and I will help you finding you daughter.
^You can look the Wooden Board to see preferences.
^Use the Campfire to rest and write down your exploration to save your progress.
^And you can catch some rest and leave reality for some time in the Tend.
^Oh! and each time you prove yourself in that forest I will give you some upgrades. Just pass by the the table with some syringes.
